title: O Come, All Ye Faithful
_about: Tune ADESTE FIDELES, checked note for note against the Open Hymnal Project score (public domain), transposed from G to C. It runs from low Sol to Sol2. Bass is the score's bass on the first beat of each bar. One beat = a quarter note (4/4).

_arrangements: Layouts found by a search that keeps every phone from ringing two notes at once and spreads quick notes between players. 1 and 2 phones play the melody only; 3 and 4 phones add the bass where it fits. Notes listed in 'alternate' sit on two phones and take turns. Spare gestures hold notes this song never uses, so a stray swing stays harmless. Sizes offered: 2, 3, 4.
